in_marathi.name: Devit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devi means 'goddess' and Deva means 'god'. Therefore, Devit can be considered as 'God of Gods'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Devit is often depicted as a powerful deity who governs the universe.

in_bengali.name: Devit
in_bengali.long_meaning: Devit একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Devi means 'goddess' and Deva means 'god'. Therefore, Devit can be considered as 'God of Gods'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Devit is often depicted as a powerful deity who governs the universe.
